heroHeadline: Israeli Drone Strike Kills Palestinian Doctor Near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital; Gaza Toll Reaches 72,939; ICJ Pleadings Schedule Confirmed
heroSubtitle: An Israeli drone strike near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah on May 30, 2026 killed Dr. Jamal Abu Aoun, head of the anaesthesia department at Al-Yafa Medical Hospital — adding to the 1,000+ healthcare workers killed in Gaza since October 2023. Gaza's Ministry of Health confirmed a cumulative toll of 72,939 killed and 172,927 wounded as of May 31; 930 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire, against 3,005 documented Israeli violations. Hezbollah fired 2 rockets at Kiryat Shmona on May 30, both intercepted. The International Court of Justice confirmed the written pleadings schedule in South Africa v. Israel (Case 192): South Africa's Reply is due November 22, 2027, and Israel's Rejoinder by May 22, 2029. Netanyahu has ordered IDF to expand territorial control from 60% to 70% of Gaza beyond the ceasefire Yellow Line while coalition polls show his bloc at 51 seats — 10 short of a governing majority ahead of expected October 2026 elections.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OCHA, IDF, Gaza Ministry of Health, B'Tselem, ICC, ICJ, Reuters, Al Jazeera, OHCHR, UNRWA, Times of Israel, Haaretz, Bloomberg, Jerusalem Post, Human Rights Watch, Save the Children, Amnesty International, UNICEF, NPR, Middle East Eye, CNN, The National, Euronews, CBC News, NBC News, FDD, WFP, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are subject to ongoing verification. The conflict has persisted since Israeli independence on May 14, 1948.
